MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 12

2. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 82

3. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 14

4. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 15
   C. 17
   D. 21

6. Solve for x: x + 8 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 17
   C. 8
   D. 10

7. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 33
   C. 4
   D. 32

8. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

9. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 11
   C. 5
   D. 24

10. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 170
   D. 169

11. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 121

12. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 48

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

3. Area = 36
Final Answer: 36 m²
